input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance covenant anywhere: a search for "insurance" returns no results, and the General Provisions (Section 10, paragraphs p0059–p0070) cover notices, relationship, assignment, waiver, governing law, severability, survival, entire agreement and headings only. HDI develops and hosts the Site and, per Section 8.1, has access to Content, user information and other Company Confidential Information, so it is a services/hosting vendor processing our data — leaving it uninsured is walk-away territory under the rule. We therefore insert a short insurance paragraph as new Section 10.9 at the preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, certificates on request), with the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert insurance covenant as new Section 10.9 in General Provisions
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a standard insurance covenant, as HDI hosts the Site and handles Company Confidential Information and user data; our playbook requires commercial general liability, professional liability and cyber cover with certificates on request. If the cyber limit is an issue we can discuss E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000 as a fallback.

ops.text: 10.9 Insurance. HDI shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law; and, where HDI processes Content, user information or other Confidential Information of the Company, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. HDI shall provide the Company with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage on request.
